name: Kasou Shinshoku ~Virtual Hack Online~
original_name: 仮・想・侵・蝕～Virtual Hack Online～
source:
Keiji Kouda, the protagonist, is an inconspicuous presence in his class, with no close friends, and is practically invisible to his classmates. 

Fed up with this reality, Keiji is addicted to a network game set in a virtual fantasy world  called "The Another World", nicknamed "TAW". Thanks to advances in computer networks and neuroscience, it's now possible to experience virtual worlds on the network as if they were real. TAW was gaining worldwide popularity as a network game that allowed players to feel a sense of reality , as if their own consciousness had been transferred to their virtual avatar . 

Disguised as a magician named Gilbert Kessler, Keiji became more noticeable in TAW than in the real world. However, this alone was not enough to satisfy Keiji's pent-up desire for self-expression. Aiming to become the commander of a legion with many players and numerous fortresses , the surest way to gain fame in TAW that everyone know, he establishes his own legion. Keiji's army, in a territorial war, managed to acquire a fort in a location where several major armies were locked in a standoff, taking advantage of the power imbalance that made it difficult for them to attack. However, in order to satisfy his own desire for self-aggrandizement, Keiji needlessly provoked the major armies surrounding the fort he had acquired. As a result, the major armies, who had temporarily joined forces, attacked simultaneously, causing Keiji's army to lose the fort, and all of his army members, disillusioned with Keiji, to leave. 

Unable to abandon his ambition to belong to one of the major armies, Keiji searched the internet in the real world for information on how to raise funds to rebuild his army. At that moment, he stumbled upon a program file. It was a powerful hacking program that could interfere with the core of TAW's game program . This hacking program could not only peek at other users' personal information but also rewrite the game's settings to his liking. However, what Keiji found most noteworthy was the function that allowed him to freely control even the safety measures placed on the feedback of information to the players. TAW has a high degree of unity between players and avatars, and various safety measures are in place because, in some cases, it could affect the player's mind and body. By freely controlling these safety measures, he could manipulate the target player's memories of what they did in the virtual world, while simultaneously planting only the feeling of being subjugated deep within their mind. By doing so, it should be possible to awaken that feeling of subjugation in the player and make them obey when certain conditions are met in the real world as well. 

Keiji repeatedly tested the tool and confirmed that its effects were largely as he had predicted. Then, he decided to use the tool to take revenge on the commanders of the major armies who had joined forces with him to destroy his own army. In the real world, this meant subjugating and enslaving the women who had treated him like air, scorned him, and looked down on him... the players who were characters serving as commanders of the major armies. Driven by the dark desires lurking in his heart, Keiji meticulously planned his next move.

translation:
主人公光田启司在班里毫不起眼，没有亲密的朋友，对同学们来说几乎是个透明人。

厌倦了这样的现实，启司沉迷于一款以虚拟幻想世界为舞台的网络游戏《另一个世界》，简称TAW。随着计算机网络与神经科学的发展，人们已经能够像体验现实一样，体验网络中的虚拟世界。TAW让玩家仿佛将自身意识转移到虚拟角色身上，获得强烈的真实感，因此在全球迅速走红。

启司化身为名叫吉尔伯特·凯斯勒的魔法师，在TAW里比现实中更受关注。然而，这还不足以满足他一直压抑的自我表现欲。成为拥有众多玩家与多座要塞的军团团长，是TAW里公认最可靠的成名之道。为了这个目标，他创建了自己的军团。在领土战争中，启司的军团利用几大军团相互牵制、难以出手的力量格局，取得了位于它们对峙地带的一座要塞。然而，为了满足自己的虚荣心，他无谓地挑衅要塞周围的几大军团。结果，这些军团暂时联手，同时发动攻击，启司的军团失去了要塞。团员们也全都对他失望，纷纷离去。

启司不肯放弃跻身大型军团的野心，于是在现实中的互联网上搜寻筹集重建资金的方法。就在这时，他偶然发现了一个程序文件。这是一个强大的黑客程序，可以干预TAW游戏程序的核心。不仅能窥探其他用户的个人信息，还能随意改写游戏设定。然而，最让启司在意的，是它可以自由控制玩家信息反馈系统中的安全措施。TAW的玩家与虚拟角色高度同步，有时甚至会对身心产生影响，因此游戏设置了多种保护机制。通过自由控制这些机制，他可以操纵目标玩家对虚拟世界经历的记忆，同时只将臣服的感觉深深植入对方内心。这样一来，在现实中满足特定条件时，应该也能唤醒玩家的臣服感，让对方服从自己。

启司反复测试这套工具，确认效果大致与预想一致。随后，他决定用它报复那些曾联手摧毁自己军团的大军团团长。在现实中，这意味着制服并奴役那些把他当作空气、轻蔑他、看不起他的女性…她们正是在游戏里担任大军团团长的玩家。心中暗藏的阴暗欲望驱使着启司，精心策划下一步行动。
